source_title: INDIA Bloc Rally: Ramlila Maidan Divided Into 14 Zones, Rainwater and Mud Pose Major Challenges
source_excerpt:
Preparations are in full swing at Delhi's Ramlila Maidan for the INDIA bloc's 'Vote Bachao, Desh Bachao' mega rally scheduled for November 1. Thousands of party workers and senior political leaders from across the country are expected to attend the massive gathering, prompting extensive arrangements for security and crowd management. The entire venue has been divided into 14 zones, with two separate stages being constructed for the event. The main stage will accommodate top INDIA bloc leaders, while the second stage will host other senior leaders from the alliance. A separate gallery has also been arranged for distinguished guests. The rally is scheduled to begin at 10 AM, and more than 250 CCTV cameras have been installed across the ground to strengthen surveillance. However, continuous rainfall over the past two days has created significant challenges for the organisers. Ground visuals show large areas covered with rainwater and mud, particularly around the seating arrangements and in front of the stages. Workers are making efforts to remove accumulated water, spread additional soil and prepare the venue ahead of the rally. Despite the challenges, stage construction, seating arrangements, entry and exit facilities and other preparations are progressing rapidly. Congress leader Rahul Gandhi has also appealed to people through a video message to participate in large numbers. Meanwhile, concerns have been raised by traders' organisations, which fear that the rally during the festive Diwali shopping season could disrupt business activities and cause losses reportedly exceeding ₹10,000 crore. With security arrangements being strengthened and weather conditions remaining a concern, all eyes are now on the November 1 rally and the expected turnout at Ramlila Maidan.
